Diverging and sequential scales

Source: R/theme.R
scale_fill_vs_average.Rd

scale_*_vs_average() centres a blue-white-red scale on midpoint (typically 0 for "difference from league average"). Red always means "better than average" for the quantity shown, so flip reverse for quantities where lower is better (turnovers, defensive rating).

Usage

scale_fill_vs_average(
  ...,
  midpoint = 0,
  reverse = FALSE,
  limits = NULL,
  oob = scales::squish
)

scale_colour_vs_average(
  ...,
  midpoint = 0,
  reverse = FALSE,
  limits = NULL,
  oob = scales::squish
)

scale_colour_league(...)

scale_fill_league(...)

Arguments

...

Passed to ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2() or ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c().

midpoint

Centre of the diverging scale.

reverse

Swap the two ends.

limits, oob

Scale limits; values outside are squished, so a single extreme cell does not wash out the rest.
